Name: Pelican Clandestine - Illicit Crops and Black Market (1.6)
Author: Xienfe
Description:
[center]
[size=6][b][color=#2ecc71]PELICAN CLANDESTINE[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4][i]Illicit Agriculture, Artisan Processing, Clandestine Chemistry & The Nocturnal Black Market[/i][/size]
[b]Designed for Stardew Valley 1.6+ | 100% Native Content Patcher | Bilingual English & Español[/b]
[/center]

[line]

[size=5][b][color=#e67e22]🌿 OVERVIEW / INTRODUCCIÓN[/color][/b][/size]

Behind the peaceful, pastoral facade of Pelican Town lies a shadow economy waiting to be tapped. [b]Pelican Clandestine[/b] brings an immersive, lore-friendly underground agricultural network to Stardew Valley 1.6+.

Cultivate clandestine crops across all seasons, cure buds and latex in custom-built drying racks, press potent hash, extract plant alkaloids in sealed maceration vats, and synthesize high-purity compounds in an underground chemistry lab. Meet the mysterious hooded Smuggler in the dark alleys of Pelican Town after 8:00 PM to buy forbidden seeds or liquidate your illicit contraband for extraordinary profits.

[quote][b]Zero C# DLLs — 100% Vanilla 1.6 Architecture:[/b] Powered natively by Content Patcher 2.4.0+. Utilizes native Stardew 1.6 [i]Data/Crops[/i], [i]Data/Objects[/i], [i]Data/Machines[/i], [i]Data/Buffs[/i], and [i]Data/Shops[/i]. Fully multiplayer compatible, lightweight, and completely localized in both [b]English[/b] and [b]Español[/b].[/quote]
[line]

[size=5][b][color=#2ecc71]🌱 1. THE 4 CLANDESTINE CROPS[/color][/b][/size]

Each crop features custom high-resolution pixel art matching the vanilla Stardew aesthetic, distinct growth phases, and continuous regrowth cycles:

[list]
[*][b]Cannabis (Cannabis Seeds):[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Seasons:[/b] Spring, Summer, Fall (Outdoor & Greenhouse/Pots).[/*]
[*][b]Growth Time:[/b] 9 days (Phases: 1, 2, 2, 2, 2 days).[/*]
[*][b]Regrowth:[/b] Continues to yield fresh buds every [b]3 days[/b].[/*]
[*][b]Harvest:[/b] Wet Cannabis Bud.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]Royal Opium Poppy (Poppy Seeds):[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Seasons:[/b] Spring, Summer.[/*]
[*][b]Growth Time:[/b] 7 days (Phases: 1, 1, 2, 2, 1 days).[/*]
[*][b]Regrowth:[/b] Scored latex-oozing pods regrow every [b]3 days[/b].[/*]
[*][b]Harvest:[/b] Scored Poppy Pod.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]Coca Bush (Coca Cutting):[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Seasons:[/b] Summer (or year-round in Greenhouse / Island).[/*]
[*][b]Growth Time:[/b] 14 days (Phases: 2, 3, 3, 3, 3 days).[/*]
[*][b]Regrowth:[/b] Fresh alkaloid-rich green leaves regrow every [b]4 days[/b].[/*]
[*][b]Harvest:[/b] Coca Leaves.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]Psilocybin Mushrooms (Psilocybin Spores):[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Seasons:[/b] Spring, Summer, Fall (Thrives outdoors, in Garden Pots, and inside the Farm Cave).[/*]
[*][b]Growth Time:[/b] 6 days (Phases: 1, 1, 1, 2, 1 days).[/*]
[*][b]Regrowth:[/b] Fresh psychoactive clusters harvestable every [b]3 days[/b].[/*]
[*][b]Harvest:[/b] Psychoactive Mushroom.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b][color=#3498db]⚙️ 2. CUSTOM PROCESSING & ARTISAN MACHINES[/color][/b][/size]

Raw clandestine harvests cannot be used immediately; they require specialized curing, extraction, and synthesis:

[list]
[*][b]Drying Rack (Tendedero de Secado):[/b]
[list]
[*] [i]Recipe:[/i] 30 Wood, 10 Fiber.[/*]
[*][b]Wet Bud[/b] ➔ [b]Cured Cannabis Bud[/b] (24 in-game hours / 1440 min).[/*]
[*][b]Scored Poppy Pod[/b] ➔ [b]Black Tar Opium[/b] (12 in-game hours / 720 min).[/*]
[*][b]Psychoactive Mushroom[/b] ➔ [b]Dried Magic Mushrooms[/b] (24 in-game hours / 1440 min).[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]Rolling Table & Press (Mesa de Liado y Prensa):[/b]
[list]
[*] [i]Recipe:[/i] 50 Wood, 2 Copper Bars.[/*]
[*][b]1x Cured Bud[/b] ➔ [b]Classic Joint[/b] (30 in-game minutes).[/*]
[*][b]5x Cured Bud[/b] ➔ [b]Hash Brick[/b] (6 in-game hours / 360 min).[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]Maceration Vat (Cuba de Maceración):[/b]
[list]
[*] [i]Recipe:[/i] 30 Hardwood, 2 Iron Bars, 3 Battery Packs.[/*]
[*][b]5x Coca Leaves[/b] ➔ [b]Coca Base Paste[/b] (48 in-game hours / 2880 min).[/*]
[*][b]2x Poppy Pod[/b] ➔ [b]Black Tar Opium[/b] (10 in-game hours / 600 min).[/*]
[*][b]1x Dried Shroom[/b] ➔ [b]Shroom Brew / Psychedelic Tea[/b] (6 in-game hours / 360 min).[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]Clandestine Lab Station (Laboratorio Químico):[/b]
[list]
[*] [i]Recipe:[/i] 100 Stone, 5 Gold Bars, 1 Battery Pack.[/*]
[*][b]1x Coca Base Paste[/b] ➔ [b]Pure Snow Bag (Cocaine)[/b] (24 in-game hours / 1440 min).[/*]
[*][b]1x Cocaine Bag[/b] ➔ [b]Crack Rock[/b] (12 in-game hours / 720 min).[/*]
[*][b]1x Black Tar Opium[/b] ➔ [b]White Dragon Bag (Heroin)[/b] (24 in-game hours / 1440 min).[/*]
[*][b]1x Refined Quartz[/b] ➔ [b]Blue Crystal[/b] (72 in-game hours / 4320 min).[/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b][color=#9b59b6]🧪 3. PRODUCT CATALOG, PRICES & CUSTOM BUFFS[/color][/b][/size]

Every refined substance provides unique gameplay mechanics and stat modifications:

[list]
[*][b]Cannabis Line:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Classic Joint:[/b] Sell: 450g | Buff: [i]Elevated & Relaxed[/i] (+2 Luck, -1 Speed, 120s).[/*]
[*][b]King-Sized Blunt:[/b] Sell: 900g | Buff: [i]Elevated & Relaxed[/i] (+3 Luck, -1 Speed, 240s). Craft with 2 Cured Buds + 1 Rolling Paper.[/*]
[*][b]Hash Brick:[/b] Sell: 1,800g | High-density compressed resin. Massive market value.[/*]
[*][b]Space Brownie:[/b] Sell: 750g | Buff: [i]Elevated & Relaxed[/i] (+2 Luck, +30 Max Energy, 300s). Cook with 1 Cured Bud + 1 Wheat Flour + 1 Sugar.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]Coca Line:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Coca Leaves:[/b] Sell: 50g | Buff: [i]Adrenaline Rush[/i] (+1 Speed, +5 Attack, 45s).[/*]
[*][b]Coca Base Paste:[/b] Sell: 1,200g | Buff: [i]Adrenaline Rush[/i] (+2 Speed, +10 Attack, 60s).[/*]
[*][b]Pure Snow Bag (Cocaine):[/b] Sell: 3,500g | Buff: [i]Adrenaline Rush[/i] (+3 Speed, +15 Attack, 90s). Unmatched speed for skull cavern runs.[/*]
[*][b]Crack Rock:[/b] Sell: 4,500g | Buff: [i]Adrenaline Rush[/i] (+4 Speed, +20 Attack, 120s). Cooked with Industrial Solvent.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]Opium Line:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Black Tar Opium:[/b] Sell: 280g | Buff: [i]Morphine Numbness[/i] (+3 Defense, +1 Luck, -1 Speed, 90s).[/*]
[*][b]White Dragon Bag (Heroin):[/b] Sell: 720g | Buff: [i]Morphine Numbness[/i] (+5 Defense, +2 Luck, -1 Speed, 150s). Absolute damage immunity.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]Psychedelic & Synthetic Line:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Psychoactive Mushroom:[/b] Sell: 320g | Buff: [i]Psychedelic Insight[/i] (+2 Mining, +64 Magnetism, 90s).[/*]
[*][b]Dried Magic Mushrooms:[/b] Sell: 750g | Buff: [i]Psychedelic Insight[/i] (+3 Mining, +128 Magnetism, 180s).[/*]
[*][b]Shroom Brew (Té Psicodélico):[/b] Sell: 1,200g | Buff: [i]Psychedelic Insight[/i] (+4 Mining, +192 Magnetism, 300s). Reveals subterranean secrets.[/*]
[*][b]Blue Crystal:[/b] Sell: 5,200g | Buff: [i]God-Tier Rush[/i] (+4 Speed, +25 Attack, +3 Mining, 180s). Synthesized from Refined Quartz.[/*]
[*][b]Industrial Solvent:[/b] Base price: 150g. Necessary reagent for chemical cookery.[/*]
[*][b]Rolling Paper:[/b] Base price: 10g. Craft 3x from 5 Fiber.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b][color=#e74c3c]🌙 4. THE NOCTURNAL BLACK MARKET & THE SMUGGLER[/color][/b][/size]

Where do you find illegal seeds in Pelican Town?
[list]
[*][b]The Hooded Smuggler (El Contrabandista):[/b]
Every night between [b]20:00 (8:00 PM) and 02:00 (2:00 AM)[/b], a hooded silhouette appears in the alley next to the streetlamp beside Pierre's General Store (Map: Town, Tile 50, 52).
Interact with him to open the [b]Clandestine Black Market[/b]:
[list]
[*] Royal Opium Poppy Seeds (150g)[/*]
[*]Cannabis Seeds (200g)[/*]
[*]Coca Bush Cutting (750g)[/*]
[*]Psilocybin Spores (300g)[/*]
[*]Rolling Paper (10g)[/*]
[*]Industrial Chemical Solvent (150g)[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]Alternative Suppliers:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Traveling Merchant (Cart):[/b] Illicit seeds appear occasionally in her rotating stock at black-market markup.[/*]
[*][b]Shadow Shop (Krobus):[/b] Krobus stocks Industrial Solvent and Psilocybin Spores in the Sewers.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]Distribution Network:[/b] Sell your finished goods directly to the Smuggler or drop them into your Shipping Bin for morning pickup![/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b][color=#f1c40f]📦 5. INSTALLATION & REQUIREMENTS[/color][/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] (v4.0.0 or higher).[/*]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] (v2.4.0 or higher).[/*]
[*]Download [b]Pelican Clandestine[/b] and unzip it into your [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font] folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game using SMAPI. Enjoy![/*]
[/list]
[line]

[center]
[size=5][b][color=#2ecc71]🇪🇸 SECCIÓN EN ESPAÑOL[/color][/b][/size]
[/center]

[b]Pelican Clandestine[/b] añade una red completa de agricultura clandestina, procesamiento artesanal y mercado negro nocturno a Stardew Valley 1.6+:

[list]
[*][b]4 Cultivos Clandestinos:[/b] Semillas de Cannabis (primavera, verano, otoño; 9 días + rebrota cada 3 días), Esquejes de Arbusto de Coca (verano; 14 días + hojas cada 4 días), Semillas de Amapola Real (primavera y verano; 7 días + bulbos cada 3 días), y Esporas Psilocibinas (primavera, verano, otoño, macetas y cueva; 6 días + rebrota cada 3 días).[/*]
[*][b]4 Máquinas de Procesado:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Tendedero de Secado:[/b] Deshidrata y cura cogollos húmedos (24h), bulbos de amapola a opio negro (12h) y setas mágicas (24h).[/*]
[*][b]Mesa de Liado y Prensa:[/b] Prensa placas de hachís de alta pureza (6h) o lía porros artesanales (30m).[/*]
[*][b]Cuba de Maceración:[/b] Macera hojas de coca en solvente para extraer pasta base (48h), bulbos de amapola o elabora té psicodélico (6h).[/*]
[*][b]Laboratorio Clandestino:[/b] Refina nieve pura / cocaína (24h), cocina rocas de crack (12h), sintetiza caballo blanco / heroína (24h) y cristal azul a partir de cuarzo refinado (72h).[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]Efectos Únicos (Buffs):[/b]
[list]
[*] [i]Elevado y Relajado:[/i] +2/+3 Suerte, paso sosegado (-1 Velocidad).[/*]
[*][i]Subidón de Adrenalina:[/i] Hasta +4 Velocidad y +25 Ataque para arrasar las Minas.[/*]
[*][i]Iluminación Psicoactiva:[/i] +4 Minería y +192 Radio de Magnetismo.[/*]
[*][i]Anestesia de Morfina:[/i] +5 Defensa y +2 Suerte (inmunidad prácticamente total al daño).[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]El Contrabandista Nocturno:[/b] Aparece en Pueblo Pelícano junto a la farola de Pierre entre las 20:00 y las 02:00 de la noche para abastecerte de semillas prohibidas, papel y disolvente.[/*]
[/list]
